On Sunday, 265,827 people spanning 192 nationalities and 158 countries took part in the 2024 Wings for Life World Run, with 3,760 people participating in the UK alone. 
Anna Morris and Alex Milne were crowned the UK winners of this year’s event, having covered 44.7km and 62.6km respectively before being caught by the Catcher Car, which was voiced by World Ironman Champion Lucy Charles-Barclay. Taking part at an in-person event in Battersea Park, London, Milne and Morris were well into ultramarathon territory by the time they finished the event as the final two participants standing.
